messages:
rafa_peopleops: FYI Sara submitted an accommodation today for chemical sensitivity (ADA intake started). Case ID: HR-2026-089. Looping @mike_manager @alex_fm @tara_hr for next steps.

sara: hi all — i've been getting frequent migraines and sore throat after being in the office. my physician advised avoiding fragranced products and strong cleaners. i'm open to a different desk, private office, or remote work. appreciate a quick plan.

mike_manager: thanks for flagging, @rafa_peopleops and @sara. i can look for a desk away from cleaning routes or a private office. will confirm availability by EOD. temporary remote ok in meantime?

alex_fm: filing with facilities now — ticket FCL-2026-4411. can you list specific triggers, @sara? e.g., scented soap, floor stripper, disinfectant sprays, plug-ins. that helps vendor select low-VOC alternatives.

facilities-bot: New ticket created: FCL-2026-4411 — "Chemical sensitivity accommodation assessment". Assigned to alex_fm. Est. response 2 business days.

leah_ops: tagging building ops — if private office HVAC is shared we can try to increase fresh air intake, disable fragrance air diffusers on that zone, and schedule cleaning outside core hours. vendor replacement to low-VOC products is feasible.

legal-team: quick note — we should document each option offered and the employee's preference. absolute scent-free guarantees are difficult in shared spaces; consider offering remote as a reasonable alternative if needed.

tara_hr: @sara we received the intake. please complete the short accommodation form (https://hr.redwood.example/intake?case=HR-2026-089) or reply here to request a confidential call. once we have clinical details HR will draft an accommodation letter within 3 business days.

mike_manager: update: private office on 6F may be available starting Monday. if that doesn't isolate HVAC, remote can be set up. @sara do you want me to reserve the office while facilities assesses?

sara: yes please reserve it if possible. if HVAC can't be isolated i'll start remote on Mon. thanks so much for moving fast.

rafa_peopleops: noted — reserving thread for coordination and will update HR tracker HR-2026-089. pls DM any sensitive attachments instead of posting here. :thumbsup:

alex_fm: vendor contact scheduled tomorrow to review cleaning products and provide low-VOC alternatives. we'll also request a targeted deep-clean of Sara's area and move any heavily fragranced soap dispensers.

tara_hr: next steps summarized: 1) Sara completes intake or schedules call; 2) Facilities does assessment (FCL-2026-4411) and recommends mitigations; 3) Manager reserves office or approves temporary remote; 4) HR issues accommodation letter and documents the agreed arrangement. target resolution: within 5 business days.

leah_ops: will follow up with HVAC data and vendor receipt. if anyone needs to escalate to building landlord for HVAC adjustments, ping me.

mike_manager: i'll touch base with sara privately later today to confirm immediate remote setup and any equipment she needs.

rafa_peopleops: thanks team — i'll log updates to the case and close this thread when final letter is signed. DM for any PII.
